end_date = datetime(2026, 12, 31, 23, 59)

events = recurring_ical_events.of(cal).between(start_date, end_date)

    ev_start = ev.decoded('dtstart')
    ev_end = ev.decoded('dtend')

        # convert to naive local/utc
        s_dt = ev_start.replace(tzinfo=None)
    else:
        s_dt = datetime.combine(ev_start, time.min)
        
    if isinstance(ev_end, datetime):
        e_dt = ev_end.replace(tzinfo=None)
    else:
        e_dt = datetime.combine(ev_end, time.min)
